chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Joins the Yinglong Guard – Crimson Dragon Mountains Orientation
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning becomes an official One-Claw Yinglong Guard. The survivors of Mount Yujue are greeted by the enchanting Daoist Yulan and learn the Guard’s privilege ladder, merit system, and the fateful choice between carefree guest elders and loyal Inner Guards.
og_title: The Crimson Dragon Orientation – Ji Ning’s First Day as an Immortal Bureaucrat
og_description: After surviving Mount Yujue, Ji Ning faces a new trial: the intoxicating charm of Primal Daoist Yulan and the Yinglong Guard’s dual-track system of freedom versus loyalty.
twitter_title: Danm, even the orientation speech is seducing me! The Guard’s recruitment pitch is wild.
twitter_description: Ji Ning and 44 survivors officially become Yinglong Guards—privileges, merit points, and a flirtatious Primal Daoist leading the briefing.
